title: अष्टषष्टितमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 68 · Fifth day: Shikhandin and Bhishma

summary.en: Shikhandin with Virata attacks the unconquerable Bhishma, and Ghatotkacha, Dhrishtaketu and Satyaki join the assault on the Kaurava chariots. Bhishma and Drona hold the Kaurava side with their forces.
summary.kn: ಶಿಖಂಡಿ ವಿರಾಟನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಅಜೇಯ ಭೀಷ್ಮನ ಮೇಲೆ ದಾಳಿ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಘಟೋತ್ಕಚ, ಧೃಷ್ಟಕೇತು, ಸಾತ್ಯಕಿ ಕೌರವ ರಥಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಎರಗುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಭೀಷ್ಮ, ದ್ರೋಣರು ಕೌರವ ಪಕ್ಷವನ್ನು ಹಿಡಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: शिखण्डी विराट के साथ अजेय भीष्म पर आक्रमण करते हैं, और घटोत्कच, धृष्टकेतु और सात्यकि कौरव रथों पर टूट पड़ते हैं। भीष्म और द्रोण कौरव पक्ष को सँभाले रखते हैं।
summary.te: శిఖండి విరాటునితో కలిసి అజేయుడైన భీష్ముని ఎదుర్కొంటాడు; ఘటోత్కచుడు, ధృష్టకేతువు, సాత్యకి కౌరవ రథాలపై పడతారు. భీష్మ ద్రోణులు కౌరవపక్షాన్ని నిలబెడతారు.
summary.ta: சிகண்டி விராடனுடன் வெல்ல முடியாத பீஷ்மரைத் தாக்க, கடோத்கசன், த்ருஷ்டகேது, சாத்யகி கௌரவத் தேர்களை நெருக்குகின்றனர். பீஷ்மரும் த்ரோணரும் கௌரவப் பக்கத்தைத் தாங்குகின்றனர்.
summary.ml: ശിഖണ്ഡി വിരാടനോടൊപ്പം തോൽപ്പിക്കാനാകാത്ത ഭീഷ്മരെ ആക്രമിക്കുന്നു; ഘടോൽക്കചനും ധൃഷ്ടകേതുവും സാത്യകിയും കൗരവ രഥങ്ങളെ ആക്രമണത്തിൽ ചേരുന്നു. ഭീഷ്മരും ദ്രോണരും തങ്ങളുടെ സേനകൊണ്ട് കൗരവ പക്ഷത്തെ താങ്ങിനിർത്തുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 6.68; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Jul 26 2021

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
शिखण्डी सह मत्स्येन विराटेन विशां पते ।
भीष्ममाशु महेष्वासमाससाद सुदुर्जयम् ॥

meaning.en: Shikhandi, together with Virata the Matsya, quickly approached the great archer Bhishma, very hard to conquer, lord of the people.

verses.text:
द्रोणं कृपं विकर्णं च महेष्वासान्महाबलान् ।
राज्ञश्चान्यान्रणे शूरान्बहूनार्छद्धनंजयः ॥

meaning.en: Dhananjaya struck Drona, Kripa, Vikarna, the mighty great archers, and many other brave kings in battle.

verses.text:
सैन्धवं च महेष्वासं सामात्यं सह बन्धुभिः ।
प्राच्यांश्च दाक्षिणात्यांश्च भूमिपान्भूमिपर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: And the great archer, the Sindhu king, with his ministers and kinsmen, and the Easterners and Southerners among the kings, bull among kings.

verses.text:
पुत्रं च ते महेष्वासं दुर्योधनममर्षणम् ।
दुःसहं चैव समरे भीमसेनोऽभ्यवर्तत ॥

meaning.en: Bhimasena went against your son, the great archer Duryodhana, the impatient, and Duhsaha in the battle.

verses.text:
सहदेवस्तु शकुनिमुलूकं च महारथम् ।
पितापुत्रौ महेष्वासावभ्यवर्तत दुर्जयौ ॥

meaning.en: Sahadeva went against Shakuni and the great chariot-warrior Uluka, the two great archers, father and son, hard to conquer.

verses.text:
युधिष्ठिरो महाराज गजानीकं महारथः ।
समवर्तत संग्रामे पुत्रेण निकृतस्तव ॥

meaning.en: Yudhishthira, great king, the great chariot-warrior, engaged the elephant division in the battle, he who was deceived by your son.

verses.text:
माद्रीपुत्रस्तु नकुलः शूरः संक्रन्दनो युधि ।
त्रिगर्तानां रथोदारैः समसज्जत पाण्डवः ॥

meaning.en: Nakula, Madri's son, the brave Pandava, who roared in the fight, engaged the noble chariot-warriors of the Trigartas.

verses.text:
अभ्यवर्तन्त दुर्धर्षाः समरे शाल्वकेकयान् ।
सात्यकिश्चेकितानश्च सौभद्रश्च महारथः ॥

meaning.en: Satyaki, Chekitana and the great chariot-warrior Abhimanyu, unassailable, went against the Shalvas and Kekayas in the battle.

verses.text:
धृष्टकेतुश्च समरे राक्षसश्च घटोत्कचः ।
पुत्राणां ते रथानीकं प्रत्युद्याताः सुदुर्जयाः ॥

meaning.en: Dhrishtaketu and the rakshasa Ghatotkacha, very hard to defeat, advanced against the chariot division of your sons.

verses.text:
सेनापतिरमेयात्मा धृष्टद्युम्नो महाबलः ।
द्रोणेन समरे राजन्समियायेन्द्रकर्मणा ॥

meaning.en: The commander Dhrishtadyumna, of immeasurable spirit and great strength, met Drona in the battle, king, who fought with Indra's skill.

verses.text:
एवमेते महेष्वासास्तावकाः पाण्डवैः सह ।
समेत्य समरे शूराः संप्रहारं प्रचक्रिरे ॥

meaning.en: Thus your great archers and the Pandavas, heroes, met in battle and fought a clash.

verses.text:
मध्यंदिनगते सूर्ये नभस्याकुलतां गते ।
कुरवः पाण्डवेयाश्च निजघ्नुरितरेतरम् ॥

meaning.en: When the sun had reached midday and the sky was in turmoil, the Kurus and Pandavas struck each other.

verses.text:
ध्वजिनो हेमचित्राङ्गा विचरन्तो रणाजिरे ।
सपताका रथा रेजुर्वैयाघ्रपरिवारणाः ॥

meaning.en: Chariots with banners, with bodies of bright gold, moving about the field with flags and tiger-skin covers, shone.

verses.text:
समेतानां च समरे जिगीषूणां परस्परम् ।
बभूव तुमुलः शब्दः सिंहानामिव नर्दताम् ॥

meaning.en: As those eager for victory met each other in the battle, a tumultuous sound arose like lions roaring.

verses.text:
तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम संप्रहारं सुदारुणम् ।
यमकुर्वन्रणे वीराः सृञ्जयाः कुरुभिः सह ॥

meaning.en: We saw there a wonderful, most dreadful clash that the Srinjaya heroes made with the Kurus in battle.

verses.text:
नैव खं न दिशो राजन्न सूर्यं शत्रुतापन ।
विदिशो वाप्यपश्याम शरैर्मुक्तैः समन्ततः ॥

meaning.en: We could see neither sky nor directions, king, nor the sun, scorcher of foes, nor the intermediate directions, because of the arrows shot on every side.

verses.text:
शक्तीनां विमलाग्राणां तोमराणां तथास्यताम् ।
निस्त्रिंशानां च पीतानां नीलोत्पलनिभाः प्रभाः ॥

meaning.en: The gleams of spears with spotless points, of lances and of arrows, and of yellow swords were like blue lotuses.

verses.text:
कवचानां विचित्राणां भूषणानां प्रभास्तथा ।
खं दिशः प्रदिशश्चैव भासयामासुरोजसा ।
विरराज तदा राजंस्तत्र तत्र रणाङ्गणम् ॥

meaning.en: The radiance of colored armor and ornaments lit up the sky, directions and intermediate directions with their brightness, and the battlefield shone here and there, king.

verses.text:
रथसिंहासनव्याघ्राः समायान्तश्च संयुगे ।
विरेजुः समरे राजन्ग्रहा इव नभस्तले ॥

meaning.en: Tigers on lion-seats of chariots, rushing into battle, shone in the battle like planets in the sky.

verses.text:
भीष्मस्तु रथिनां श्रेष्ठो भीमसेनं महाबलम् ।
अवारयत संक्रुद्धः सर्वसैन्यस्य पश्यतः ॥

meaning.en: But Bhishma, best of chariot-warriors, enraged, held back the mighty Bhimasena while the whole army watched.

verses.text:
ततो भीष्मविनिर्मुक्ता रुक्मपुङ्खाः शिलाशिताः ।
अभ्यघ्नन्समरे भीमं तैलधौताः सुतेजनाः ॥

meaning.en: Then arrows loosed by Bhishma, gold-feathered, whetted on stone, oil-washed and keen, struck Bhima in the battle.

verses.text:
तस्य शक्तिं महावेगां भीमसेनो महाबलः ।
क्रुद्धाशीविषसंकाशां प्रेषयामास भारत ॥

meaning.en: Mighty Bhimasena sent a spear of great speed, like an angry viper, at him, Bharata.

verses.text:
तामापतन्तीं सहसा रुक्मदण्डां दुरासदाम् ।
चिच्छेद समरे भीष्मः शरैः संनतपर्वभिः ॥

meaning.en: Bhishma in the battle cut that spear with its golden shaft, hard to withstand, with smooth-jointed arrows as it suddenly came.

verses.text:
ततोऽपरेण भल्लेन पीतेन निशितेन च ।
कार्मुकं भीमसेनस्य द्विधा चिच्छेद भारत ॥

meaning.en: Then with another sharp yellow broad-headed arrow he cut Bhimasena's bow in two, Bharata.

verses.text:
सात्यकिस्तु ततस्तूर्णं भीष्ममासाद्य संयुगे ।
शरैर्बहुभिरानर्छत्पितरं ते जनेश्वर ॥

meaning.en: Then Satyaki, quickly reaching Bhishma in battle, struck your father, lord of men, with many arrows.

verses.text:
ततः संधाय वै तीक्ष्णं शरं परमदारुणम् ।
वार्ष्णेयस्य रथाद्भीष्मः पातयामास सारथिम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Bhishma, fitting a sharp and most dreadful arrow, brought the Vrishni's charioteer down from his chariot.

verses.text:
तस्याश्वाः प्रद्रुता राजन्निहते रथसारथौ ।
तेन तेनैव धावन्ति मनोमारुतरंहसः ॥

meaning.en: When the chariot's driver was killed, king, his horses ran off, swift as mind and wind, wherever they went.

verses.text:
ततः सर्वस्य सैन्यस्य निस्वनस्तुमुलोऽभवत् ।
हाहाकारश्च संजज्ञे पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम् ॥

meaning.en: Then a tumultuous noise arose from all the army, and a cry of woe from the great-souled Pandavas.

verses.text:
अभिद्रवत गृह्णीत हयान्यच्छत धावत ।
इत्यासीत्तुमुलः शब्दो युयुधानरथं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: "Run at them! Seize the horses! Hold them! Run!" Such was the tumultuous shout around Yuyudhana's chariot.

verses.text:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु भीष्मः शांतनवः पुनः ।
व्यहनत्पाण्डवीं सेनामासुरीमिव वृत्रहा ॥

meaning.en: At that very time Bhishma, Shantanu's son, again struck down the Pandava army like the slayer of Vritra striking the asura host.

verses.text:
ते वध्यमाना भीष्मेण पाञ्चालाः सोमकैः सह ।
आर्यां युद्धे मतिं कृत्वा भीष्ममेवाभिदुद्रुवुः ॥

meaning.en: Struck by Bhishma, the Panchalas with the Somakas, resolving on the noble course in battle, rushed at Bhishma himself.

verses.text:
धृष्टद्युम्नमुखाश्चापि पार्थाः शांतनवं रणे ।
अभ्यधावञ्जिगीषन्तस्तव पुत्रस्य वाहिनीम् ॥

meaning.en: And the Parthas too, led by Dhrishtadyumna, rushed at Shantanu's son in the battle, wishing to defeat your son's army.

verses.text:
तथैव तावका राजन्भीष्मद्रोणमुखाः परान् ।
अभ्यधावन्त वेगेन ततो युद्धमवर्तत ॥

meaning.en: So too your men, headed by Bhishma and Drona, rushed with speed at the enemy; and then the battle went on.
